data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate the superiority of retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg versus placebo in glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Additional Glycemic Control
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in additional measures of glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Weight Management

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand - Treatment Regimen Estimand (HbA1c)
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Type 2 Diabetes and inadequate glycemic control with diet and exercise alone, naïve to insulin therapy (except gestational diabetes or ≤14 days for acute treatment), and not treated with any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications within 90 days prior to study entry, with HbA1c ≥7.0% to ≤9.5% (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population) Summary measure: Difference in least squares means of change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40 between each retatrutide dose and placebo.

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention before Week 40. Under the treatment regimen estimand, treatment adherence is considered part of the treatment condition; all data are used regardless of whether discontinuation occurs.

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medications
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates additional antihyperglycemic medications during the study. Under the treatment regimen estimand, this is considered part of the treatment condition; all data are used regardless of whether this event occurs.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant undergoes dose modification or dose interruption. This is considered part of the treatment condition and not an intercurrent event.

data.treatment: Retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, or 12 mg once weekly versus Placebo once weekly for 40 weeks, with allowance for dose interruptions and dose modifications regardless of adherence to study intervention or initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medications
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline in HbA1c (%) at Week 40
data.summaryMeasure: Difference in least squares means of change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40 between each retatrutide dose and placebo
